failure_modes: Oversimplified world that produces artifacts of the model
Funding pressure to name the outcome before the search
gloss: Vary the rules of simple agents in simulation to see which yield interesting collective behavior
invariants: Rules apply to individual agents, not to the outcome
The outcome is observed after running, not assumed
mechanism: Start from a vague intuition about a phenomenon, define simple individual agents with tunable rules, and run the simulation while varying parameters. Observe under which conditions the phenomenon (such as a dominance hierarchy) emerges. The result is discovered, not specified, and deep learning is a large instance of the same search over unit rules.
